dimensions.assessment: Directly affects all U.S. citizens registering to vote and casting ballots in federal elections, as well as state and local election officials nationwide.
Substantially changes voter registration and voting procedures by conditioning registration and ballot access on specific physical documents and photo identifications.
Prohibits federal agencies from charging fees for citizenship verification requests, but does not provide specific implementation cost figures.
Amends the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 and the Help America Vote Act of 2002, creating extensive new mandates for states.
Imposes permanent nationwide requirements on federal election administration.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill institutes sweeping changes to federal election administration by requiring documentary proof of U.S. citizenship for voter registration, mandating photo identification to vote in federal elections, and establishing state verification processes.

card.summary: S. 5271 amends the Help America Vote Act of 2002 to establish federal photo identification requirements for individuals voting in federal elections, covering both in-person and mail-in or absentee voting methods. It defines acceptable forms of identification, provides for provisional ballots under certain conditions, requires states to offer free public access to digital imaging devices for copying identification, and sets an effective date one day after enactment.

other.label: CBO cost estimate: S. 1383, Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act of 2025

summary: The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (or the SAVE America Act) requires individuals to provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections. It also requires voters to present valid photo identification when casting ballots in federal elections, either in person or alongside mail-in ballots. States must check their voter rolls against federal databases to remove noncitizens and establish processes for alternative proof or handling name discrepancies.

affected_groups.effect: Must provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship alongside their registration applications.
Must present valid physical photo identification when voting in person or include identification copies or social security information for mail-in voting.
affected_groups.group: Voters casting ballots in federal elections

affected_groups.effect: Must verify citizenship documentation, check voter rolls against federal databases within 30 days, remove noncitizens, and provide free public access to digital imaging devices.
Must compare state voter lists using the SAVE system, respond to state verification requests within 24 hours without charging fees, and investigate unlawfully registered aliens.
affected_groups.group: Department of Homeland Security and Federal Agencies

key_provisions: Prohibits states from processing federal voter registration applications unless the applicant provides documentary proof of U.S. citizenship, such as a REAL ID, passport, military ID, or birth certificate.
Requires states to submit their official lists of eligible voters to the Department of Homeland Security for comparison using the SAVE system to identify and remove noncitizens.
Requires individuals voting in person in federal elections to present a valid physical photo identification, with provisions for provisional ballots under specific conditions.
Requires individuals voting other than in person to submit a copy of a valid photo ID or the last four digits of their Social Security number with a specific affidavit.

Establishes criminal penalties for executive branch officers or employees who provide material assistance to a noncitizen in registering or voting, or for registering an applicant who fails to present citizenship proof.
Mandates that state and local governments provide public access to digital imaging devices at no cost to allow individuals to copy photo identification.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary costs associated with implementing the database checks, public copying devices, and administrative changes.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (or the SAVE America Act) requires individuals to provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections. It also requires voters to present valid photo identification when casting ballots in federal elections, either in person or alongside mail-in ballots. States must check their voter rolls against federal databases to remove noncitizens and establish processes for alternative proof or handling name discrepancies.
summary_detail.significance: This bill significantly alters federal election administration by standardizing nationwide documentary proof-of-citizenship requirements for voter registration and photo identification mandates for casting ballots. It shifts federal-state cooperation regarding voter roll verification through databases like SAVE and introduces new criminal penalties related to noncitizen registration.

title: Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act of 2025
